title: Sidebar navigation to Finance renders the finance page

Click the sidebar link to open Finance

title: Open full-screen clock from Home and return to Home

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the clock widget to open the full-screen clock view

title: Navigate months and pick a specific month/year
description: Verifies the user can navigate between months with arrows and jump to a chosen month/year and the calendar grid updates accordingly.

Select a different month and year in the picker

title: Start and stop a study timer session for a selected topic
description: Verifies a user can select a topic, start the study timer, stop it, and see a saved session confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /study
Click to add a new study topic
Fill Study Timer Topic 01 into the topic title field
Save the new topic
Select the subject/topic Study Timer Topic 01 for the session
Start the study timer
Wait for the elapsed time to increase
Stop the timer
Verify a session saved confirmation is visible

title: Finance totals update after adding income and expense across categories
description: After adding income and expense transactions across categories, the finance page shows updated today totals, accumulated totals, and net balance.

steps.description: Navigate to /finance
Click to create a new finance category
Fill "IncomeCat" into the category name field
Submit the category creation form
Open the "IncomeCat" category from the categories list
Select Income transaction type
Click a preset amount to add a transaction
Click to return to the finance categories list
Click to create a new finance category
Fill "ExpenseCat" into the category name field
Submit the category creation form
Open the "ExpenseCat" category from the categories list
Select Expense transaction type
Click a preset amount to add a transaction
Verify the finance summary section shows updated today totals and net balance

title: Create a calendar event with notes and quick-start and see indicator on the date
description: Verifies a user can create a calendar event with type, name, time, notes, and quick-start enabled, and an indicator appears on the selected date.

steps.description: Navigate to /calendar
Click a date on the calendar grid to select it
Choose an event type icon
Fill Event With Notes 01 into the event name field
Select a valid event time
Fill Add notes for this event into the notes field
Toggle the quick-start option on
Save the event
Verify an event indicator appears on the selected date

title: Create an event and view its details from the indicator popup
description: Verifies the user can create an event for a selected date and then open an indicator popup to see the event details.

steps.description: Navigate to /calendar
Select a date cell in the current month
Create a new event for the selected date with a type, a name, a valid time, and notes
Save the event
Click the event indicator on that date
Verify an event details popup is displayed with the event name, type, time, and notes
